about: The work machine's tillr backend policy for spending the owner's Claude subscription. A drain names this file with --policy when it should run on the subscription; backend-policy.bedrock.json beside it is the same machine's Bedrock-only policy, and backend-policy.json is the personal machines' policy. Every seat runs on the Claude Code command line (the claude adapter). The Bedrock backends remain declared but are not selected by these seats. Why and how: docs/reference/tillr-claude-backend.md. Several policy files is the stopgap docs/design/tillr-convergence.md OQ-TC2 records: the target is that tillr names only seats and the machine's profile resolves them, at which point this file is deleted.
